card.title: Can You Keep It?
card.instruction: Use increasingly sensitive details to test whether someone deserves deeper trust.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I withdrew my college application. Have you told Mum?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked. I said my sister's plans were hers to explain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then there's more. I've leased a bakery. Can I send you the address?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Call me. Mum uses my tablet; she'd see the message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good catch. I'll call. It's Mum's old bakery. I want you there when I tell her.

mechanism: A rewards demonstrated discretion with progressively more sensitive disclosure and a request for deeper involvement.
confusable: Unlike telling a secret all at once, A must test trust and increase exposure in response to B's handling.
comparison: The eligible sibling scene tests both verbal discretion and device privacy; protected D131-a remains untouched.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
